_doc: EXP-CAL (SIMULATION_SPEC.md section 9.1). Runs before the freeze. Writes results/summary/calibration.json.

field_tiers._targets: Mean first-attempt success (including 'don't know') at E = E*, over the default population. Design targets of the Report 5 question bank.

adjustment_rules._doc: If a target is missed, change only the directly responsible parameter, re-run, and log the change in DECISIONS.md. Stop after max_iterations and report to the researcher.
